# Draft:Shigeo Nagashima Award

The Shigeo Nagashima Award (長嶋 茂雄), commonly known as the Nagashima Award, is an honor planned to bestowed upon a player in Nippon Professional Baseball each year for one who "excels in the three fundamentals of baserunning, hitting and fielding, and who captivates fans each season."
The award was established in November of 2025 between NPB, the Yomiuri Shimbun and the Nippon Television Network to honor Nagashima, who served as the lifetime honorary manager of the Yomiuri Giants. The award will be chosen by a committee of former pro baseball players and others that is announced after the conclusion of the Japan Series. The recipient will be given a commemorative medal and ¥3 million.
